result.what_interviewer_wanted: They wanted a clear definition of overfitting, methods to detect it (train/validation gap), and a range of prevention techniques with an example from a project.
result.improved_answer: Overfitting happens when a model performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data, usually because it has learned noise. I detect it by looking for a large gap between training and validation accuracy. To prevent it, I use regularization (L1/L2), add more training data or augment it, simplify the model, and apply early stopping or dropout in neural nets. In my campus policy assistant project, I monitored the validation loss and stopped training when it stopped improving, which reduced overfitting and improved generalization.
result.one_tip: Add a brief mention of how you verify that the remedy works, such as checking the validation curve.
result.feedback_summary: Good start—clear definition and mention of regularization, but add more detail on detection and a broader set of techniques.
